entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states via temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains while providing observable retrieval trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships to manage information. It supports multi-tenant company deployments and performs gap analysis to identify missing data within user queries.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while offering byte-level deduplication and connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across more than 25 LLM providers. It is deployable via Docker or Kubernetes and supports both Python and Node.js clients for flexible storage backend integration.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with dedicated SDKs and supports managed, local, or Docker-based deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system employs a seven-layer memory architecture, including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki, to manage agent state. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and playbooks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes based on task success.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management through a hierarchical DAG of depth-aware summary nodes. It uses a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original message data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library, enabling private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, and supports any OpenAI-compatible inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and allows agents to import data from external sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML format called engrams to store human-readable data on local disks for multi-agent systems. It facilitates retrieval through a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings, supported by Model Context Protocol integration.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes Agent via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system of BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to maximize prefix reuse. This native Hermes Agent plugin reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of prompt tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a CLI for local-first management.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Telegram or Discord.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to avoid opaque databases.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens. This local-first architecture uses SQLite and FTS5 to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94% with minimal overhead.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal for semantic retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent recall. It features a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer provides a deterministic lifecycle kernel for hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration workflow for importing documents and includes an opt-in catalog for documenting external tools.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that features real event deletion and an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to support tools for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It settles payments directly to wallets with 0% fees and integrates with agent frameworks like elizaOS.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing for skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It includes five native tools for searching and fetching, with support for automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for models with structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that uses a git-backed directory of markdown files to manage memory without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously. It enforces a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development to ensure reliable software creation.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system that provides 26 CLI executables for prototyping and exporting artifacts to formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It features a sandboxed iframe preview for live iteration and supports integration with Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent security capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions and Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets along with self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. It utilizes a master router and connector skills to manage delegated permissions and payments.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for varying tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution through merging and cross-pollination across multiple agents like Hermes and QwenPaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and skill development.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the Agent Plugins spec v1.0.0. It maintains persistent state across sessions by storing data within the project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It features ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms such as Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin provides capabilities for video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing on YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical instructions and thinking lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular skill packages using progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency. It supports programmatic skills, remote registries, and resources for Pydantic AI agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for different project scales and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs source file edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes a mechanism kernel to operate without a background service. It organizes workflows through four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—and requires Herdr for hosting rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project provides interoperable skills for interacting with Chainlink oracle networks. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, as well as specialized CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources specifically in Portuguese. All contributions follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models into agent workflows. The modules include specialized support for cinematic inserts, archival formats, and optimized prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a CLI and Python client for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also features a commerce layer that supports skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language that audits AI tasks for costs, permissions, and types before local execution via a single Rust binary. It ensures accountability by generating hash-chained, tamper-evident receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for credential validation and utilizes Nextcloud App Passwords for secure HTTPS communication.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye implements a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation if specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub serves as a community platform for browsing and installing skills according to the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows a Hermes agent to handle system design while the user interacts via a task-completion interface.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: HermaGuard performs adversarial code reviews using three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like CLI and Discord, scoring them across five quality dimensions. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates to prevent early-stop errors. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three subagents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It supports multiple languages including Rust and Go, featuring a tiered application process with a final approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This comprehensive lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested tools for session management, multi-session reconciliation, and worktree recovery. It enhances agent memory between conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial code reviews.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate demo GIFs for repository READMEs. It ensures output files are optimized under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to prevent drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. It gates these updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators while operating locally via the Python standard library.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and agents like Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills by testing them within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills manage deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. They ensure file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments via x402.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured reports with actionable conclusions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides tools for video-to-text conversion, OCR, and agent memory management compatible with the agentskills.io standard. It supports various operations across macOS, Linux, and Windows depending on the specific skill selected.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills through a hosted MCP server for structured web data access. It is built to support multiple agent environments including Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It integrates tools from various providers like Google and OpenAI into a reproducible development environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that bundles official Hermes installations with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes a REST API and CLI for managing per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, reboot-safe deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers using systemd. It configures the Hermes Gateway for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to power specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It includes a dedicated Portfolio Manager to handle final transaction approval and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Designed for self-hosted orchestration, this tool governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface to manage persistent coding agent sessions via tmux. It supports multi-repo workspace management and sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and can detect HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales from single agents to automated teams via a task bus pattern. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform allows users to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It features a Kanban board for task tracking, live streaming of agent reasoning, and human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Built on Hermes Agent profiles, this web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing project structures. It automatically synchronizes the index on every file change and supports multiple languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based dashboard and web visualization tool designed to track token usage across various AI coding agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It allows developers to monitor consumption metrics and submit data to public profiles or leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other AI providers build better user interfaces. It integrates directly with markdown-supporting agents to provide structured UI development assistance.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It features multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It provides control over visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to reverse recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities and automatic context recall for frameworks and chat bots on platforms like Telegram and Slack. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents, allowing for specialized skills and custom instructions within specific directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins, offering a zero-cost path to a production-ready environment.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts to flag overlapping tool descriptions or inconsistent schemas. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks, utilizing HERM v1.1 scoring for validation.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles the setup of systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It operates entirely offline across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro, requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup is a local-first skill designed to help users generate revenue using dynamic slash commands and a deterministic local runtime. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or writes performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It centralizes the management of Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with 21 professional assistants specialized in creating PPT, Word, and Excel documents. It facilitates remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent by providing guided installation and provider setup. The application includes a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages five agent runtimes and unified configurations across 10 platforms, including Discord and Slack. It enables the creation of visual workflows with approval gates and provides tool traces and file previews.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager for comprehensive agent oversight.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime for site-aware drafting in 31 environments. It features live browser control that requires explicit approval gates for agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server via HTTPS or Tailscale to support real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Operating locally on macOS 14+ without telemetry, this cockpit tracks live session quota burn by model, tokens, or cost. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for 15 different agent sources.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a kanban board for agentic work and task management. It allows users to manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets through a terminal-based chat environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to validate Telegram sessions.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to operate. It connects to both cloud and local AI models and features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a dedicated file browser for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration settings. It allows for full review of conversation histories and skill source code while tracking session activity and costs.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers. It uses isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate for different workflows.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents via a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store containing over 50 curated one-click installations for expanding agent capabilities.
